name: CodeFlow Studio Architecture Rules
description: Enterprise Architectural Quality Gate Ruleset for Spring Boot & React

rules.name: Controller-Repository Separation
rules.description: Controllers must not directly depend on Repository interfaces. All database persistence operations must flow through a Service layer.

rules.name: No Circular Dependencies
rules.description: Components must maintain acyclic dependency graphs. Circular dependency chains between services or packages are strictly prohibited.

rules.name: Service-Controller Separation
rules.description: Service and Domain layer classes must not depend on Controller or Presentation layer components.

rules.name: JPA Entity Validation
rules.description: Model and entity classes must be annotated with @Entity and specify a primary key annotated with @Id.

rules.name: REST API Naming Convention
rules.description: REST endpoints must use standard kebab-case lowercase path segments.

rules.name: Security Annotation Coverage
rules.description: Mutating REST endpoints (@PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping) must have explicit security authorizations (@PreAuthorize, @Secured, or @RolesAllowed).
